nodes.description: Owner address stored in Owned contract; set to msg.sender in constructor and updated in acceptOwnership.
Pending owner address set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Token symbol string, set to 'GBT' in the constructor.
Token name string, set to 'Goinbit.com Token' in the constructor.
Token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
Total token supply constant, used by constructor and totalSupply().
Mapping of account address to token balance; mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to allowance; mutated by approve, approveAndCall and transferFrom.
Checked addition helper (a + b) with overflow require; used by transfer and transferFrom.
Checked subtraction helper (a - b) with underflow require; used by transfer and transferFrom.
Checked multiplication helper (a * b) with overflow require.
Checked division helper (a / b) with divide-by-zero require.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner.
Accepts ownership when msg.sender equals newOwner and transfers ownership.
Constructor of the GoinbitToken contract; mints total supply to a fixed address and sets metadata.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Returns the token balance of tokenOwner from the balances mapping.
ERC20 transfer; updates balances of msg.sender and to using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
ERC20 approve; sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval.
ERC20 transferFrom; debits from balance and allowance of msg.sender and credits to balance.
Returns remaining allowance of spender for tokenOwner.
Sets allowance then performs an external call to spender.receiveApproval, enabling reentrancy into the caller.
Payable fallback function that always reverts, rejecting ETH.
onlyOwner function that externally calls transfer() on an arbitrary token address, sending tokens to owner.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balance accounting and allowance accounting.
External call to an attacker-supplied contract via ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval, executed after allowance state update.
External call to an arbitrary token contract via ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens).

edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as owner during construction, establishing the privileged owner account.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier that compares msg.sender to owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal the pending newOwner before transferring ownership.
msg.sender identifies the balance account debited in transfer.
msg.sender is the allowance owner key written in approve.
msg.sender is used as the spender key when decrementing allowance in transferFrom.
msg.sender is both the allowance owner and the from argument forwarded in the external receiveApproval call.
Addend parameter flows into the addition performed by safeAdd.
Addend parameter flows into the addition performed by safeAdd.
Return local variable receives the result computed by safeAdd.
Recipient address parameter is credited inside transfer.
Token amount parameter is debited/credited inside transfer.
Success flag is produced and returned by transfer.
From address parameter is the balance key debited in transferFrom.
To address parameter is the balance key credited in transferFrom.
Token amount parameter is subtracted from balance and allowance in transferFrom.
Success flag is produced and returned by transferFrom.
Spender parameter is the allowance key and the external call target in approveAndCall.
Token amount parameter is written to the allowance mapping in approveAndCall.
Arbitrary data parameter is forwarded into the external receiveApproval call.
Success flag is produced and returned by approveAndCall.
Token contract address parameter is the target of the external call in transferAnyERC20Token.
Token amount parameter is passed to the external ERC20 transfer call.
Success flag is returned directly from the external ERC20 transfer call.
New owner parameter is stored into the newOwner state variable.
Spender parameter keys the allowance mapping in approve.
Token amount parameter is stored as the allowance value in approve.
Token owner parameter keys the balances mapping lookup in balanceOf.
Token owner parameter keys the allowed mapping lookup in allowance.
Spender parameter keys the allowed mapping lookup in allowance.
transfer relies on safeAdd for checked credit arithmetic; unchecked use of the helper can hide overflow assumptions.
transfer relies on safeSub for checked debit arithmetic on the caller balance.
transfer writes updated balances into the balances mapping.
transferFrom uses safeAdd for the recipient credit arithmetic.
transferFrom uses safeSub for both balance and allowance decrements.
transferFrom decrements the caller's allowance in the allowed mapping.
approve writes the new allowance into the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowance into the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall hands control to an arbitrary spender contract via receiveApproval, enabling reentrant calls back into the token.
transferAnyERC20Token makes an external call to a caller-supplied token contract, which can reenter with malicious behaviour.
transferAnyERC20Token sends the drained tokens to the privileged owner address.
transferOwnership writes the provided address into the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership overwrites the owner state variable with the pending newOwner.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0) after the ownership transfer.
Constructor sets the symbol state variable.
Constructor sets the name state variable.
Constructor sets the decimals state variable.
Constructor sets the total supply state variable.
Constructor mints the total supply into the fixed deployer address in the balances mapping.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] when computing the circulating supply.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the requested account.
allowance reads the allowed mapping for the owner/spender pair.
